semiconductor_relevance: High — Iwatsu Electric specializes in high-voltage and high-current measurement solutions critical for semiconductor testing and analysis.
summary: Iwatsu Electric provides advanced measurement solutions for power electronics, focusing on high-voltage and high-current applications. Their product offerings include optical isolation probes and curve tracer systems, which are essential for testing and analyzing semiconductor devices, particularly in the context of SiC and GaN technologies.
capabilities: 1.5 GHz Optical Isolation Voltage Probe for high-side gate signal observation
Ultra-Low Inductance Wideband Shunt Resistor for current measurement
High-Voltage, High-Current Curve Tracer System for static characteristics and C-V measurements
High-Speed TLP Testing for ESD analysis
